chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: Slim and Slam in Los Angeles in 1940-41 and local jam sessions
summary: The duo went to L.A. around 1940, played the Swanee Inn and attended after-hours jam sessions with local musicians.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So now, like what did you do as of 1941 then, when the Slim and Slam band broke up?
Yes, we happened to be out in California at that particular time, in L. A. We had been out
there since, oh, let's see, 1940. We left New York and went out and played a couple of spots out there in L. A.
Do you remember which places you went?
One of the place was called the --
places was called the Swanee Inn and, oh --
Did you play Club Alabam or New Mode, Forest Mills?
No, I never played the -- no, but I did attend quite a bit of jam sessions they used to have on -- I think it was Vermont Avenue, a place, an after hours spot.
Now, who were some of the musicians? Were they local L. A. musicians or --
Do you remember who any of the guys were that you were playing?
